Adds an order status update endpoint for support agents to mark orders as shipped from the order detail page, with timestamp tracking and role-based access control.

- New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

Support currently handles roughly 400 status updates per week over email, with 20–40 minute handoffs that sometimes get lost between inboxes. Yes

ALTER TABLE Orders ADD StatusUpdatedAt datetime2 NULL;

The `StatusUpdatedAt` column is nullable, so existing orders will hold `NULL` until their first status update. The endpoint returns `404 Not Found` when the order does not exist and `204 No Content` on success. Only users in the `Support` role may invoke the endpoint.
